# ZefNet protocol-v1 oracle fixtures

These binary files are copied byte-for-byte from `/Users/ulf/dev/zef/crates/zefnet_message_encoding/fixtures/` on 2026-08-27.

They are generated by Zef's canonical constructors through `crates/zefnet_message_encoding/tools/generate_fixtures.py` and consumed by the Rust codec's golden tests.

When the Rust wire protocol changes, regenerate the Rust fixtures first, copy the corresponding files here, and update `test/zefnetWire.test.ts` before changing the TypeScript codec.
